tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, panels, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page ground (cool marble). Default background.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Sunken wells: table headers, code blocks, tank interiors.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, focus-adjacent outlines, chart axes. 3:1 on surface-000 and surface-100.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on surface-000, surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, units, timestamps on surface-000 and surface-100.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Reservoir teal: the drop, primary actions, links, selected state.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed primary; brand-coloured text on surface-100.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Water fill in tank diagrams; quiet brand backgrounds.

tokens.name: verify
tokens.usage: Validation bluish-green: the V in the wordmark and the verified check. Large marks and icons only, never body text.

tokens.name: status-reuse
tokens.usage: REUSE state: water verified, irrigation valve open. Always with the word and check icon.

tokens.name: on-status-reuse
tokens.usage: Text on status-reuse.

tokens.name: status-hold
tokens.usage: HOLD state: irrigation blocked, water held or drained. Always with the word and alert icon.

tokens.name: on-status-hold
tokens.usage: Text on status-hold.

tokens.name: status-hold-edge
tokens.usage: Outline of HOLD badges and rows so the light amber fill holds its edge on white.

tokens.name: status-standby
tokens.usage: STANDBY state: no treatment, no irrigation.

tokens.name: on-status-standby
tokens.usage: Text on status-standby.

tokens.name: status-backwash
tokens.usage: BACKWASH state: filter cleaning from the treated tank.

tokens.name: on-status-backwash
tokens.usage: Text on status-backwash.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Critical events only: power loss, valve mismatch, sensor dropout.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset.
